title: Accounts endpoints: /v1/me, preferences
goal: Clients can read and update their own account through `/v1/me` with ETag concurrency, and learn the plan summary, active workspace and entitlement revision in one call.
scope_in: `GET /v1/me`: current user (id, email, display_name, locale, avatar_slot, telemetry, created_at), plan summary, active workspace (id, name, role), entitlement revision `ent`; returns `ETag`.

`PATCH /v1/me`: partial update of display_name (1-40), locale (BCP 47), avatar_slot, telemetry (opt-in); honours `If-Match` (mismatch -> `412 precondition_failed`); returns the updated resource and new ETag.
Active workspace resolution: token `wsp` claim if the user is still a member, else the user's personal workspace.
Plan summary from an injected `EntitlementsLookup` (default free plan from CT-ENTITLEMENTS defaults) so billing lanes plug in later.
Audit event on each successful PATCH via an injected `AuditSink`.
scope_out: Account deletion and data export endpoints (B026).
Devices and API keys endpoints (B020, B019).
build_against: B017 test principal helper, B013 service, B010 stack; entitlements via stub lookup.
interfaces: `GET /v1/me` (scope `profile`) -> 200 `{user, plan:{id: 'free'|'pro'|'team', status}, workspace:{id, name, role}|null, ent: number}` + `ETag`.
`PATCH /v1/me` (scope `profile`, header `If-Match`) body any subset of `{display_name, locale, avatar_slot, telemetry}`; unknown fields ignored per CT-VER.
`interface EntitlementsLookup { forUser(userId: string, workspaceId?: string): Promise<{plan: 'free'|'pro'|'team'; status: string; rev: number}> }`.
acceptance: GET with a valid token returns 200 with an `ETag` header and `ent` equal to the stub's revision; without a valid token returns 401 with `token_invalid` or `token_expired` as appropriate.
PATCH `{display_name:'Ada'}` with a matching `If-Match` returns 200 and a different ETag; with a stale ETag returns 412 `precondition_failed` and changes nothing.
PATCH with a 41-char name, control chars, or an invalid locale returns a validation problem with `errors[].pointer` `/display_name` or `/locale`.
Unknown fields (e.g. `{foo:1}`) are ignored and do not cause a 400.
A token with only scope `workspaces:read` gets 403 on both routes; an API-key principal gets 403 on PATCH.
The GET response contains no refresh tokens, secrets or other users' data; a snapshot test pins the exact key set.
Two concurrent PATCHes with the same If-Match: exactly one succeeds, the other gets 412.
tests: me.patch.test.ts: validation matrix, unknown fields, If-Match 412.
scopes.test.ts: profile scope and API-key denial.
active-workspace.test.ts: claim valid, invalid, membership removed.
guardrails: MUST NOT allow changing email, id or status through PATCH.
MUST NOT return or log the email of any user other than the caller.
MUST honour If-Match atomically (compare-and-set in SQL), never read-then-write.
MUST NOT trust the `wsp` claim without checking current membership.
failure_modes: Entitlements lookup unavailable -> respond 200 with the free-plan fallback; log `entitlements_unavailable` at most once per minute.
User row deleted -> 404; `pending_deletion` -> 200 with the status visible.
